bagPolicy.summary: Under UW’s posted policy, bags up to 8.5" x 11" and clear totes up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. Backpacks and larger bags are not.
allowed: Clear totes up to 12" x 6" x 12"
bagPolicy.note: This is the UW Kohl Center carry-in policy written for athletics events; UW applied the same bag limits at past Kohl Center concerts. There is no on-site storage for prohibited items.
